EVAL-P-MEASURE-3-S11.title: Enforce Disciplinary Signal Response Schema in Service Output
EVAL-P-MEASURE-3-S11.description: Ensure provider_detail_service outputs disciplinary signal data in a consistent schema (presence_indicator, board_lookup_url, state) aligned with existing contract definitions.

EVAL-P-MEASURE-3-S12.title: Implement Presence Indicator Derivation Rules
EVAL-P-MEASURE-3-S12.description: Define and implement logic for determining when a disciplinary signal should be marked as present based on availability of state board lookup links and valid provider state data.

EVAL-P-MEASURE-3-S13.title: Handle Unsupported or Missing State Data
EVAL-P-MEASURE-3-S13.description: Add logic to gracefully handle providers with missing, invalid, or unsupported state values by suppressing disciplinary signals or returning a null-safe structure.

EVAL-P-MEASURE-3-S14.title: Validate Disciplinary Signal Mapping in Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-P-MEASURE-3-S14.description: Ensure disciplinary signal fields are correctly mapped and preserved when passed through evaluate_care_facade into API responses, including null handling and field naming consistency.

EVAL-P-MEASURE-3-S15.title: Edge Case Testing for Incomplete Provider Data
EVAL-P-MEASURE-3-S15.description: Extend test coverage to include edge cases such as missing NPI fields, malformed state codes, and partial provider records to ensure disciplinary signal robustness.
